title: Kagamine Len — A Moment After School〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope you figure it out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Same!
And thank you too, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll see you two later!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, good luck!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Saki seemed a little better than when she came.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, she did...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, I was surprised to hear that their show didn't go so well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Especially since they seemed to be doing great lately.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Do you think it's because they didn't play at their usual venue?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That may be a part of it...
But based on what Saki said...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I guess I should start by talking about how our show went...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You guys probably heard that we'd be performing somewhere different than usual.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we couldn't get anybody in that crowd there going at all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Until now, we always knew that getting everyone going would be pretty hard, but at least some people would listen intently...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And then, I decided to ask someone from this band that the crowd really seemed to love about our songs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They said, “I thought they were cute. But they didn't really strike a chord with me.”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Geez, talk about being blunt...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: However, compared to the song we wrote for Hanano and her brother, the song I wrote for this show was...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They were cute but didn't really strike a chord, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess we should start by listening to the song she wrote for that show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, here's the file Saki gave us. I'll play it now. Ready?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I can see how someone might say it lacks a real message compared to the song they wrote for those fan siblings.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I like this song since it's so catchy.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's like everyone's having fun and I'm being invited to join them, you know?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I agree...
I see no real fault with that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's a nice expression of how Saki's feeling and having fun right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And yet, it didn't work for the people at that live house...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Based on Saki's story, this crowd seemed to include people who mostly just wanted to chill, listen and gradually get into a song.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hmm...
It's pretty easy to chalk stuff like this up to bad luck.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But Saki doesn't want to do that...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right. Which is why she wants to write a song that really hits home with them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I get that, but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I really don't want her to toss aside something that she worked so hard to create.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's a great expression of how dazzling her life is right now, so flatly labeling it as “bad” seems a bit...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, it's like saying how Saki feels is wrong somehow.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Len...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't worry. I'm sure she understands that and just needs to find a better way to express herself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's likely why she came to talk to us. She wants to figure out how to write a song that really resonates with others.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She's probably taking a really hard look at what she's feeling right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (We believe in you, Saki!)
